prompt: How many versions of the .NET platform have been released that have a support lifetime of more than 12 months?
answer: 12 versions. The listed .NET/.NET Core releases include 13 versions, but .NET Core 3.0 was supported for less than 12 months (September 23, 2019–March 3, 2020). The other 12 had support lifetimes exceeding one year.
